title: Microbes Are Thinking
hook: Right now, microbes inside your mouth are actively predicting your next move.
script: Right now, microbes inside your mouth are actively predicting your next move. How do simple organisms without a brain exhibit complex problem solving? When E. coli senses sudden warmth, it turns off oxygen genes before ever reaching your gut. Colonies communicate using potassium channels, firing electrical waves exactly like human brain cells. Mother microbes store cellular memories, passing critical lessons down to four generations of offspring. This microbial intelligence allows swarms to outsmart your immune system by waiting until their numbers are lethal. Would you classify single-celled life as truly intelligent—yes or no?
